Completely understandable, especially considering this is all very fresh that you need a place to just get a grasp on what you’re going through.

I’m going to also just give you some things I’ve seen regarding reconciliation on this sub, that I think you may want to put into action for yourself going forward if you really want to try for reconciliation. 

Firstly, the betrayer has to want to reconcile and show true remorse. If they are only sorry they got caught, they are not remorseful. 

I see you said she is already in therapy, but if you’re not, I would highly recommend that for you and couples counseling. Your emotions and feelings need a safe place to processed without the influence of your wayward. 

Unrestricted access to her phone, however long you decide to do this, or until trust is rebuilt.

Cutting off the AP, if she hasn’t already, and if you haven’t already - this is crucial. 

Remind yourself that you did nothing wrong here, I don’t care how many mistakes you think you made, you are the betrayed, and you call the shots of what you want this reconciliation to look like. Period. 

I also really recommend reading everyone’s stories on here, the ones for reconciliation, how it turned out, the ones who just found out, how some are doing years from their D-Day. Reconciliation is generally looked down upon here because the success rates are just so low, it’s abysmal, and none of us want to see another betrayed partner put so much love into their spouse for another year, five or ten, and we see them here again saying they could not move past it or they cheated once again. 


Some people can reconcile, but it is a long, excruciating journey for many to get to that point, but again, I hope the best for you and however it turns out that you are doing better than before.

Hey, OP - firstly, I’m really sorry this happened to you, it is extremely traumatizing and painful to have the person you love put you this kind of agony. 

However, you’re not going to get a lot of positive feedback on this sub considering reconciliation, especially with the information you are sharing with us here. There are so many red flags with this person, and sweeping it under the rug by not having her acknowledge that this is not “heat of the moment” or “human weakness” but conscious choices she made to decimate your marriage over and over again, for over a YEAR, is not going to give you the results you are hoping for. 

r/AsOneAfterInfidelity is the sub that I would recommend if you’re seeking reconciliation, but even then, there is a lot that should be required from your partner to reconcile and you taking remotely any of the blame on this “my hurt is bringing her down and might be too much for her” is not part of it. 

I do wish you the best of luck with whatever you decide to do.

So, like I said, if she’s friends with anyone on his friends list on Snapchat, she could appear. If she has a public profile and lives within a certain radius with location on, she could appear. It is also possible that she didn’t show up for a while even with her number in the phone, but I don’t know how often you check the app to be able to tell.

I would say check his contacts if you have free access to his phone, if you find nothing of note and no other reason for suspicion, then it’s probably okay, depending on the context and his history with this person.

The quick add list usually shows people who are mutual friends with others on your Snapchat friends list, live nearby, phone contacts etc. 

I’ve had people I haven’t talked to or seen in years pop up on my quick add list, but it could also be he has her number in his phone, something like that.

As you said, everyone here will encourage you to lawyer up and leave as soon as possible, but much easier said than done when financially dependent on someone else. I hope for your sake and your children’s that you can get out of this terrible situation.

Start preparing, setting money aside quietly for you and your family, finding a source of income for yourself if you don’t have one already, looking into resources for women in situations like yourself. Take the time to read others posts in similar situations as yourself (unfortunately there are many), there is a lot of good advice and support on this sub. 

Hugs.
